select sum(indicatorValue)
from (with tmp as (select to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                      as indicatorDate,
                          count(distinct case activity_type_code
                                             when '1'
                                                 then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as outpatient_cnt,
                          count(distinct case activity_type_code
                                             when '2'
                                                 then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as emergency_cnt,
                          count(distinct case
                                             when activity_type_code in ('5', '6', '9')
                                                 then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as hospitalization_cnt
                   from visit a
                   where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
                     and to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
                     and to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
                   group by to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
                   order by to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
      select 'outpatient_cnt' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate, outpatient_cnt as indicatorValue
      from tmp
      where outpatient_cnt > 0
      union all
      select 'emergency_cnt' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate, emergency_cnt as indicatorValue
      from tmp
      where emergency_cnt > 0
      union all
      select 'hospitalization_cnt' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate, hospitalization_cnt as indicatorValue
      from tmp
      where hospitalization_cnt > 0
) a
where indicatorCode = 'outpatient_cnt';

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (with tmp as (select to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                      as indicatorDate,
                          count(distinct case activity_type_code
                                             when '1'
                                                 then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as outpatient_cnt,
                          count(distinct case activity_type_code
                                             when '2'
                                                 then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as emergency_cnt,
                          count(distinct case
                                             when activity_type_code in ('5', '6', '9')
                                                 then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as hospitalization_cnt
                   from visit a
                   where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
                     and to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
                     and to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
                   group by to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
                   order by to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
      select 'outpatient_cnt' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate, outpatient_cnt as indicatorValue
      from tmp
      where outpatient_cnt > 0
      union all
      select 'emergency_cnt' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate, emergency_cnt as indicatorValue
      from tmp
      where emergency_cnt > 0
      union all
      select 'hospitalization_cnt' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate, hospitalization_cnt as indicatorValue
      from tmp
      where hospitalization_cnt > 0
) a
where indicatorCode = 'emergency_cnt';

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (SELECT TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                  AS indicatorDate,
             COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                WHEN activity_type_code IN ('1', '2')
                                    THEN visit_id || a.id_card ||
                                         TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS indicatorValue
      FROM visit a
      WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                    FROM medical_expense_rec rec
                    WHERE rec.medical_cost_pay_type_code IN ('01', '02', '03', '09')
                      AND a.visit_id = rec.visit_id)
        AND treatment_occurrence_time >= '2025-01-01'
        AND treatment_occurrence_time < CURRENT_DATE
      GROUP BY TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      ORDER BY indicatorDate) a;

select sum(indicatorValue) from (SELECT TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
                                        COUNT(DISTINCT
                                              CASE
                                                  WHEN activity_type_code IN ('1', '2')
                                                      THEN a.visit_id || a.id_card ||
                                                           TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                                  END
                                        )                                                AS indicatorValue
                                 FROM visit a
                                          LEFT JOIN patient b
                                                    ON a.source_patient_id = b.source_patient_id
                                 WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                   AND treatment_occurrence_time >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                                   AND b.sex_code = '1'
                                   AND treatment_occurrence_time < CURRENT_DATE
                                 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) a

select sum(indicatorValue) from (SELECT TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
                                        COUNT(DISTINCT
                                              CASE
                                                  WHEN activity_type_code IN ('1', '2')
                                                      THEN a.visit_id || a.id_card ||
                                                           TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                                  END
                                        )                                                AS indicatorValue
                                 FROM visit a
                                          LEFT JOIN patient b
                                                    ON a.source_patient_id = b.source_patient_id
                                 WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                   AND treatment_occurrence_time >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                                   AND b.sex_code = '2'
                                   AND treatment_occurrence_time < CURRENT_DATE
                                 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(treatment_occurrence_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) a

select sum(indicatorValue) from (
                                    SELECT
                                        TO_CHAR(visit_date_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
                                        COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_card || a.visit_id || TO_CHAR(a.execute_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS indicatorValue
                                    FROM examination_record a
                                             LEFT JOIN visit vs ON vs.visit_id = a.visit_id
                                    WHERE
                                        a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                      AND EXISTS (
                                        SELECT 1 FROM visit v
                                        WHERE v.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                          AND v.visit_id = a.visit_id
                                          AND v.activity_type_code IN ('1', '2')
                                    )
                                      AND visit_date_time >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                                      AND visit_date_time < CURRENT_DATE
                                    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(visit_date_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                    ORDER BY TO_CHAR(visit_date_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) a;

select sum(indicatorValue) from (
                                    SELECT
                                        TO_CHAR(inspection_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
                                        COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_card || a.visit_id || TO_CHAR(inspection_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS indicatorValue
                                    FROM inspection_record a
                                             LEFT JOIN visit vs ON a.visit_id = vs.visit_id
                                    WHERE
                                        EXISTS (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM visit v  -- 修正schema名称，移除internal.前缀（假设为笔误）
                                            WHERE v.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                              AND v.activity_type_code IN ('1', '2')
                                              AND v.visit_id = a.visit_id
                                        )
                                      AND a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                      AND inspection_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                                      AND inspection_date < CURRENT_DATE
                                    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(inspection_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                    ORDER BY TO_CHAR(inspection_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) a;

select sum(indicatorValue) from (
                                    with tmp as (
                                        select to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')             as indicatorDate,
                                               sum(nvl(a.outpatient_cost, 0))                        as outpatient_cost,
                                               sum(nvl(a.outpatient_cost, 0)) -
                                               nvl((sum(case
                                                            when a.medical_cost_pay_type_code in ('01', '02', '03')
                                                                then nvl(personal_cost, 0) end)), 0) as outpatient_insurance_cost
                                        from medical_expense_rec a
                                        where modify_flag in ('1', '2')
                                          and to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
                                          and to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
                                        group by to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
                                    )
                                    select 'outpatient_cost' as indicatorCode,indicatorDate,outpatient_cost as indicatorValue from tmp where outpatient_cost > 0
) a;

select sum(indicatorValue) from (
                                    SELECT
                                        TO_CHAR(cost_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
                                        COALESCE(
                                                SUM(
                                                        CASE
                                                            WHEN item_type IN ('1', '2', '3', '11')
                                                                AND patient_type_code IN ('01', '02')
                                                                THEN total_cost
                                                            END
                                                ),
                                                0
                                        ) AS indicatorValue
                                    FROM encounter_medical_cost a
                                    WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                      AND cost_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                                      AND cost_date < CURRENT_DATE
                                    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cost_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                    ORDER BY TO_CHAR(cost_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) a;

select sum(indicatorValue) from (
                                    SELECT
                                        TO_CHAR(prescription_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
                                        COUNT(1) AS indicatorValue
                                    FROM prescription_record a
                                    WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
                                      AND prescription_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                                      AND prescription_date < CURRENT_DATE
                                    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(prescription_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                    ORDER BY TO_CHAR(prescription_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) a;

select
    a.itemCode as itemCode,
    a.itemName as itemName,
    sum(a.itemValue) as cnt
from (
        select to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as indicatorDate,
             examination_item_code               as itemCode,
             examination_item_name               as itemName,
             count(1)                            as itemValue
        from examination_record a
               left join examination_exam b on a.dcid = b.dcid and b.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
        where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
        and to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
        and to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
        and exists(select 1 from visit b where a.visit_id = b.visit_id and b.activity_type_code IN ('1', '2'))
        group by to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), examination_item_code, examination_item_name
        order by to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
) a
group by a.itemCode,a.itemName
order by cnt desc;

select
    a.itemCode as itemCode,
    a.itemName as itemName,
    sum(a.itemValue) as cnt
from (
         SELECT
             TO_CHAR(a.charging_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
             a.item_type AS itemCode,
             b.dict_label AS itemName,
             SUM(a.total_cost) AS itemValue
         FROM encounter_medical_cost AS a
                  LEFT JOIN qmjk_dict b ON a.item_type = b.dict_code
         WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
           AND a.item_type IS NOT NULL
           AND a.item_type <> ''
           AND a.item_name <> ''
           AND a.item_name <> '-'
           AND a.charging_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
           AND a.charging_date < CURRENT_DATE
           AND b.dict_type = 'CC63_12_001_06'
         GROUP BY
             TO_CHAR(a.charging_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
             a.item_type,
             b.dict_label
         ORDER BY
             TO_CHAR(a.charging_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) a
group by a.itemCode,a.itemName
order by cnt desc;

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         select to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                      as indicatorDate,
                count(distinct case
                                   when activity_type_code in ('5', '6', '9')
                                       then concat(visit_id, id_card, treatment_occurrence_time) end) as indicatorValue
         from visit a
         where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
           and to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
           and to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
           and exists(select 1
                      from medical_expense_rec b
                      where medical_cost_pay_type_code in ('01', '02', '03', '09')

         group by to_char(treatment_occurrence_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         select to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as indicatorDate, count(distinct concat(id_card, visit_id, execute_date)) as indicatorValue
         from examination_record a
         where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
           and exists(select 1 from visit where modify_flag in ('1', '2') and visit_id = a.visit_id and activity_type_code in ('5', '6', '9'))
           and to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
           and to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
         group by to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
         order by to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         select to_char(inspection_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as indicatorDate, count(distinct concat(id_card, visit_id, inspection_date)) as indicatorValue
         from inspection_record a
         where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
           and a.activity_type_code in ('5', '6', '9')
           and exists(select 1 from visit where modify_flag in ('1', '2') and visit_id = a.visit_id)
           and to_char(inspection_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
           and to_char(inspection_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
         group by to_char(inspection_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

) a;

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         with tmp as (
             select to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')             as indicatorDate,
                    sum(nvl(a.hospization_total_cost, 0))                 as hospitalization_cost,
                    nvl((sum(case when a.medical_cost_pay_type_code in ('01', '02', '03', '09') then nvl(a.hospization_total_cost, 0) end) -
                         sum(case
                                 when a.medical_cost_pay_type_code in ('01', '02', '03', '09')
                                     then nvl(personal_cost, 0) end)), 0) as hospitalization_insurance_cost
             from medical_expense_rec a
             where modify_flag in ('1', '2') and source_patient_id_type = 'IV'
               and to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
               and to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
             group by to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
         )
         select 'hospitalization_cost' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate,hospitalization_cost as indicatorValue from tmp
) a;

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         select to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                                            as indicatorDate,
                sum(case when a.item_type_code in ('1', '11', '2', '3') then nvl(total_cost, 0) else 0 end) as indicatorValue
         from advice_cost a
         where modify_flag in ('1', '2')
           and to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
           and to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
         group by to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
         order by to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
) a;

select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         with tmp as (
             select to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')             as indicatorDate,
                    sum(nvl(a.hospization_total_cost, 0))                 as hospitalization_cost,
                    nvl((sum(case when a.medical_cost_pay_type_code in ('01', '02', '03', '09') then nvl(a.hospization_total_cost, 0) end) -
                         sum(case
                                 when a.medical_cost_pay_type_code in ('01', '02', '03', '09')
                                     then nvl(personal_cost, 0) end)), 0) as hospitalization_insurance_cost
             from medical_expense_rec a

               and to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
               and to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
             group by to_char(a.settle_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

         select 'hospitalization_insurance_cost' as indicatorCode, indicatorDate,hospitalization_insurance_cost as indicatorValue from tmp
) a;

items.metric_name: 住院医保患者药品费用
items.sql:
select sum(indicatorValue)
from (
         select to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                                            as indicatorDate,
                sum(case when a.item_type_code in ('1', '11', '2', '3') then nvl(total_cost - self_cost - self_care_cost, 0) else 0 end) as indicatorValue
         from advice_cost a
         where modify_flag in ('1', '2')
           and to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
           and to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < current_date
         group by to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
         order by to_char(cost_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
) a;

select
    a.itemCode as itemCode,
    a.itemName as itemName,
    sum(a.itemValue) as cnt
from (
         SELECT
             TO_CHAR(a.diag_n_osis_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
             a.diagnose_code as itemCode,
             b.dict_label as itemName,
             COUNT(a.dcid) as itemValue
         FROM diagnose_record a
                  LEFT JOIN qmjk_dict b ON b.dict_type = 'ICD-10' and b.dict_code = a.diagnose_code
         WHERE a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
           AND exists(select 1 from visit where modify_flag in ('1', '2') and visit_id = a.visit_id and activity_type_code in ('5', '6', '9'))
           AND a.diagnose_code IS NOT NULL
           AND a.diagnose_code <> ''
           AND a.diagnose_code <> '-'
           AND a.diag_n_osis_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
           AND a.diag_n_osis_date < CURRENT_DATE
         GROUP BY
             TO_CHAR(a.diag_n_osis_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
             a.diagnose_code,
             b.dict_label
) a
group by a.itemCode,a.itemName
order by cnt desc;

select
    a.itemCode as itemCode,
    a.itemName as itemName,
    sum(a.itemValue) as cnt
from (
         SELECT
             TO_CHAR(a.cost_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS indicatorDate,
             a.item_type_code AS itemCode,
             b.dict_label AS itemName,
             SUM(a.total_cost) AS itemValue
         FROM advice_cost AS a
                  LEFT JOIN qmjk_dict b ON a.item_type_code = b.dict_code
         WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1', '2')
           AND a.item_type_code IS NOT NULL
           AND a.item_type_code <> ''
           AND a.item_type_name <> ''
           AND a.item_type_name <> '-'
           AND a.cost_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
           AND a.cost_date < CURRENT_DATE
           AND b.dict_type = 'CC63_12_001_06'
         GROUP BY
             TO_CHAR(a.cost_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
             a.item_type_code,
             b.dict_label
         ORDER BY
             TO_CHAR(a.cost_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) a
group by a.itemCode,a.itemName
order by cnt desc;

select
    a.itemCode as itemCode,
    a.itemName as itemName,
    sum(a.itemValue) as cnt
from (
         with t1 as (select dcid,id_card, visit_id, to_char(operation_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as  operation_date_time
                     from operation_record a where a.modify_flag in ('1', '2')),
              t2 as (select dcid,to_char(b.operation_start_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as operation_start_date_time,operation_code
                     from operation_operation b where b.modify_flag in ('1', '2')
                                                  and to_char(b.operation_start_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= '2025-01-01'
                                                  and to_char(b.operation_start_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < CURRENT_DATE
                                                  and b.operation_level_code in('1','2','3','4'))
         select t2.operation_start_date_time as indicatorDate,t2.operation_code as itemCode,c.dict_label as itemName,
                count(distinct concat(id_card, visit_id, operation_date_time,operation_code)) as itemValue from t2
                                                                                                                    left join t1 on t1.dcid=t2.dcid
                                                                                                                    left join qmjk_dict c on c.dict_code = t2.operation_code
         where t1.dcid is not null
         group by t2.operation_start_date_time,t2.operation_code, c.dict_label
         order by t2.operation_start_date_time
) a
group by a.itemCode,a.itemName
order by cnt desc;
